test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Advanced Full Test - 04
subject: general
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statement:**

Some birds are trees

All farms are rocks

All trees are farms

**Conclusions:**

I. Some birds are rocks

II. Some birds are not farms.

III. All farms are trees
solution:
The possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d215fe58e171517c5db7ed451891f7293fb0d11c8eaca7db96dcf47bbefa30c.png] 

Explanation;

I. Some birds are rocks → True (as some birds are trees and all trees are rocks. So,those birds which are trees are also rocks).

II. Some birds are not farms → False.(it is possible but not definite)

III. All farms are trees → False.(it is possible but not definite)

Therefore, **only conclusion I follows.**
